# Manifest

> Build, publish, and run websites and apps by chatting with Claude.

## Overview

- [Manifest — Build and publish with Claude](https://manifestx.dev/): Live on your own domain, with sign-ins and saved data built in. From a simple site to a full platform, without leaving Claude. No hosting accounts or API keys.

## Compare

- [Manifest compared — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/compare): How building and publishing with Manifest in Claude compares with other AI app builders, on pricing, features, and ownership.
- [Manifest vs Lovable — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/compare/lovable): Both build apps by chatting with AI. Lovable spends credits on every request. Manifest builds through the Claude plan you already have, and publishing is free.
- [Manifest vs Webflow — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/compare/webflow): Webflow is a visual design canvas, priced per site plus seats. Manifest builds by chatting in Claude, and publishes to your own domain for free, with…
- [Manifest vs Bolt — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/compare/bolt): Both build sites and apps by chatting with AI. Bolt spends tokens on every request and keeps custom domains for paid plans. Manifest builds through your…
- [Manifest vs v0 — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/compare/v0): Both build sites by chatting with AI. v0 spends credits on every message and hosts on Vercel. Manifest builds through the Claude plan you already have, and…
- [Manifest vs Framer — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/compare/framer): Framer is a visual site builder whose AI agent spends monthly credits. Manifest builds by chatting in Claude, and publishes to your own domain on the free plan.
- [Manifest vs WordPress — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/compare/wordpress): WordPress sites start from themes many other sites share, with plugins to keep updated. With Manifest, you describe a site that's yours alone, and publish it…
- [Publishing from AI chat apps — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/compare/ai-chat-apps): Chat apps share what they make as a link on their own address. Add Manifest to Claude, and it becomes a real site on your own domain, with staging, ready to…

- [GitHub Sync — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/platform/github-sync): An optional backup and full history of your project on GitHub.

## API docs / Guides

- [Guides — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/api/guides): Create projects, publish them, and run them.
- [Projects — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/api/guides/projects): Create a project for anything you publish, find it again by your own id, and give people access to it.
- [Edit — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/api/guides/edit): Read and change a project's files.
- [Docs Template — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/api/guides/docs-template): Generate a documentation site from Markdown pages in one request.
- [Publish — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/api/guides/publish): Publish a build, take it live, and roll back.
- [Domains — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/api/guides/domains): Serve a project on a domain of its own.
- [Webhooks — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/api/guides/webhooks): Get told when a publish goes live or fails, a promote or rollback lands, or a project is deleted, instead of polling.
- [Usage — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/api/guides/usage): See what your API account used in a month, per project.

## Framework docs / Getting Started

- [Introduction — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/getting-started/introduction): A website and app framework built directly into HTML. No bundler, no build step, no boilerplate.
- [Setup — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/getting-started/setup): Get Manifest with CDN links or copied from GitHub.
- [Starter Project — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/getting-started/starter-project): Kickstart new websites and apps with a turnkey template.
- [Compatibility — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/getting-started/compatibility): Designed to work in all major browsers.
- [Accessibility — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/getting-started/accessibility): Allow your project to support all audiences.
- [Performance — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/getting-started/performance): What Manifest optimizes, what to reach for, and how to measure.

## Framework docs / Core Modules

- [Core Modules — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules): The built-in modules that power data, routing, components, and more.
- [Chat — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/chat): Add conversations with AI or people to your project.
- [Components — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/components): Reusable HTML templates with route-bound rendering.
- [Computed Values — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/computed): Named values built from other data, recalculated only when that data changes.
- [Devices — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/device): Share sheets, secure storage, deep links, push, lifecycle, haptics, biometrics and the camera as Alpine magics that fall back to the web.
- [Form Submissions — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/submissions): Send contact forms to your email or any endpoint.
- [Import/Export — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/import-export): Move files out of the page and back in — downloads and uploads of documents and data.
- [Local Data — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/local-data): Load YAML, JSON, or CSV files as reactive data sources.
- [Localization — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/localization): Localize your project to different languages and regions.
- [Markdown — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/markdown): Render markdown into HTML, with callouts, frames, components, and highlighted code blocks.
- [Payments — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/payments): Integrate payment providers with your project.
- [Rich Text — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/rich-text): A text field with formatting, built from your own markup and storing markdown.
- [Controls — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/rich-text-controls): Buttons, dropdowns, toolbars, and menus that format Rich Text fields.
- [Router — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/router): Set page navigation paths in your project.
- [Status — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/status): Track the health of your services and display it with $status.
- [URL Parameters — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/url-parameters): Keep filters, search, and view state in the URL with $url.
- [Virtual Lists — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/virtual): Render long lists, tables, grids, and galleries efficiently with windowed scrolling.
- [Visual Editing — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/edit): Turn a live page into its own editor.
- [Move — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/move): Drag pieces to reorder them, nest them, and move them between regions.
- [Resize — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/resize): Resize elements by their edges, with limits, snap points, and closing.
- [Publishing — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/core-modules/edit-publishing): Send edits to your own backend, or write them into your source files.

## Framework docs / Appwrite Modules

- [Appwrite Modules — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/appwrite-modules): Auth, databases, storage, and presence backed by Appwrite.
- [Appwrite Setup — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/appwrite-modules/appwrite-setup): Use Appwrite to turn Manifest projects into production-ready applications.
- [Auth — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/appwrite-modules/auth): Implement a complete authentication solution for your app with a connected Appwrite project.
- [Users — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/appwrite-modules/users): Enable guests and user accounts in your project.
- [Teams — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/appwrite-modules/teams): Allow users to work together within your application.
- [Cloud Data — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/appwrite-modules/cloud-data): Access Appwrite databases and storage with the same $x API as local data.
- [Databases — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/appwrite-modules/databases): Query and manage Appwrite database tables.
- [Storage — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/appwrite-modules/storage): Upload, view, and download files from Appwrite storage buckets.
- [Presence — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/appwrite-modules/presence): Show who's here and what they're up to, live, with $presence.

## Framework docs / Elements

- [Elements — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements): Pre-styled HTML elements and interactive widgets.
- [Accordions — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/accordions): Collapsible content panels that expand on demand.
- [Avatars — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/avatars): User profile images with status indicators and fallbacks.
- [Badges — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/badges): Compact labels for status, counts, and tags.
- [Buttons — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/buttons): Interactive elements that trigger actions.
- [Charts — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/charts): Reactive SVG charts, from simple sparklines to live dashboards.
- [Chats — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/chats): Conversation layouts with message bubbles, attachments, and input composers.
- [Checkboxes — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/checkboxes): Form controls for selecting one or more options.
- [Code — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/code): Syntax-highlighted code elements using standard HTML, with numerous configurable options.
- [Color Pickers — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/color-pickers): Visual color selection with Hex, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH inputs.
- [Comboboxes — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/comboboxes): Collect entries or chips in filterable fields.
- [Date Pickers — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/date-pickers): Calendar dates, ranges, and times with native fallbacks and full localization.
- [Dialogs — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/dialogs): Popover overlays for focused interactions.
- [Dividers — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/dividers): Horizontal and vertical lines for visual separation.
- [Dropdowns — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/dropdowns): Anchored menus for actions and selections.
- [Forms — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/forms): Structured input layouts with built-in validation.
- [Icons — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/icons): Inline SVG icons from Iconify via the x-icon directive.
- [Inputs — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/inputs): Single-line text fields with validation states.
- [Radios — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/radios): Form controls for selecting one option from a group.
- [Ranges — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/ranges): Sliders for numeric input with optional steps.
- [Selects — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/selects): OS-native dropdown lists for choosing options.
- [Sidebars — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/sidebars): Collapsible navigation panels anchored to a viewport edge.
- [SVGs — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/svgs): Inline vector graphics with reactive styling.
- [Switches — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/switches): Binary toggle controls with on/off states.
- [Tables — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/tables): Structured layouts for tabular data with grid and striped variants.
- [Tabs — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/tabs): Sectioned content with switchable panels.
- [Textareas — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/textareas): Multi-line text fields with auto-resize and validation.
- [Toasts — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/toasts): Transient notifications anchored to the viewport.
- [Tooltips — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/tooltips): Hover and focus hints for inline annotations.
- [Typography — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/framework/elements/typography): Heading, paragraph, and inline text styling.
